settings.content: The brand palette. Every colour picker in the theme offers these colours, and the colour schemes start from them: Background, Ink (text), Accent (headings, links, buttons), On accent (text on accent), Muted (captions, footer links), Border, On image (text over photographs), Cream and Grey (scheme backgrounds).
A section or block shows the page colours unless its Colour scheme is set to one of these. Each scheme follows the palette until you tick Customise this scheme.

settings.content: Cucuyo self-hosts its brand fonts: Persona Medium for headings and labels, Junction for body text. They load from the theme's assets — no external requests.

settings.label: Global heading size
settings.info: Multiplies every Persona size that follows it (headings, labels, card names). The store runs at 110%.

settings.label: Global body size
settings.info: Multiplies the scaled Junction sizes (body text, descriptions, editorial paragraphs). The store runs at 90%.

settings.label: Use custom fonts
settings.info: Replaces Persona and Junction everywhere with the two fonts below. Off = the brand fonts (nothing extra loads).

settings.content: The padding sizes offered by every section (Top padding, Bottom padding). Nothing uses them until a section picks one.

settings.label: Size on phones
settings.info: The share of the desktop padding kept on phones (under 750px) by sections whose design shrinks their padding there; as the variable --space-mobile-ratio. 45% as designed.

settings.label: Page margin
settings.info: Outer padding for text content (header, labels, footer)

settings.label: Page margin on mobile
settings.info: Phones only (under 750px). Desktop and tablet keep the page margin above.

settings.label: Grid gap
settings.info: Hairline gap between grid images, as in the design

settings.label: Space between sections
settings.info: The white line between one section and the next, on every page. 4px is the design's.

settings.label: Menu drawer width
settings.info: Width of the mobile menu drawer (under 768px)

settings.label: Card shape
settings.info: The image ratio every product card is cropped to

settings.label: Space between images
settings.info: The gap in the grid itself. Keep it small for a tight field of images — the text keeps its own space below.

settings.label: Info padding (left)
settings.info: Keeps the text off the image's left edge

settings.label: Info padding (right)
settings.info: Horizontal room the text keeps to its right so one card's price never meets the next card's title. Raise this, not the gap, if they crowd.

settings.label: Info padding (top)
settings.info: Space between the image and the text below it

settings.label: Info padding (bottom)
settings.info: Room under the text before the next row of images

settings.label: Name inset
settings.info: How far the name over a photograph sits from its left and right edges (from 750px wide). 20px as designed.

settings.label: Bug size
settings.info: The Cucuyo bug beside the name of the brand's own pieces, as a share of the name's size. 190% as designed.

settings.label: Name colour
settings.info: Every card name and its bug. Empty = as designed; a card's own colour still wins.

settings.label: Name colour on hover
settings.info: Every card name while the pointer is over the card (tablet and desktop). Empty = no change, as designed; a card's own hover colour still wins.

settings.label: Space between swatches
settings.info: 8px reads as one blob at 16px swatches; 12-14 separates them

settings.label: Space above the swatches
settings.info: Fixed gap from the text above, the same on every card whatever its title length

settings.label: Enable scroll animations
settings.info: Subtle fades and image reveals. Automatically disabled for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Displayed at 32 × 32 px
